name: Airport terminal concession
mission: enplaning, deplaning, connecting and worker flow exposed to the location
decision_object: current terminal concession package in the exact security zone
required_gate: airport, terminal, security side, circulation zone and live concession package
prohibited_substitutions: airport centroid or neighborhood population cannot create terminal demand
airside and landside flows cannot be merged

name: Arena / event concession
mission: ticketed attendees and workers traversing the same venue zone
decision_object: current concession package in the exact venue zone
required_gate: named venue, live concession package and governed event calendar
prohibited_substitutions: nearby resident population cannot replace ticketed attendance
event peaks cannot be annualized into an ordinary day

name: Campus-adjacent street counter
mission: students, faculty and staff using public campus access
required_gate: public storefront routed to an accessible public campus gate or entrance within the 5/10-minute contract
prohibited_substitutions: education jobs cannot replace enrollment
H3 adjacency cannot cross a private campus boundary

name: Campus-captive kiosk
mission: authorized campus population using governed internal paths
decision_object: current food-service opportunity inside the governed campus access regime
required_gate: named campus building/internal zone and live institutional food-service opportunity
prohibited_substitutions: external neighborhood population cannot be added
campus anchor cannot create an available kiosk

name: Cultural-venue cafe
mission: venue visitors, staff and authorized users exposed to the same governed internal zone during venue operating and programming hours
decision_object: open museum, library or theater/performing-arts place with an unambiguous exact-intersection building assignment plus a separately observed cafe or concession opportunity
required_gate: named venue, internal/public access zone and live food-service opportunity
prohibited_substitutions: venue presence cannot replace attendance
nearby residents cannot be added to internal demand

name: Destination flagship
mission: Primary evidence components: TOURIST_VISITOR, SHOPPING_ERRAND
decision_object: available and legally usable large-format public cafe unit supporting the declared flagship, event, queue, accessibility, egress and back-of-house program
required_gate: destination-access contract plus flagship-scale available property and program feasibility
prohibited_substitutions: destination place density cannot replace visits
property scale cannot add customer demand

name: Destination high-street cafe

tourism guide labels cannot create a numeric score

name: Destination roastery flagship

prohibited_substitutions: production capacity cannot add customer demand
roastery program cannot create visitor counts

name: Drive-through coffee
